say:2:1541105002:1.text: Merlin said lots of mages can make familiars—magic creatures that do their bidding.
say:2:1541105002:1.source_cn: 梅林说，很多魔法师都会创造使魔，驱使它们帮助自己做事。

say:4:1541105003:1.text: Hamsters? Are they like us Wildborn?

say:7:1541105005:1.text: Merlin said familiars are born entirely from magic. That makes them very loyal.
say:7:1541105005:1.source_cn: 梅林说，使魔完全由魔力创造，所以对自己的主人非常忠心。
say:7:1541105005:1.male: Merlin said familiars are born entirely from magic. That makes them very loyal.
say:7:1541105005:1.female: Merlin said familiars are born entirely from magic. That makes them very loyal.

say:10:1541105008:1.text: Sometimes I wish I could follow you back to your world... Just stay with you, like one of your familiars.
say:10:1541105008:1.source_cn: 其实，我很想跟随您前往您所在的时空，永远陪伴您……就像...
say:10:1541105008:1.male: Sometimes I wish I could follow you back to your world... Just stay with you, like one of your familiars.
say:10:1541105008:1.female: Sometimes I wish I could follow you back to your world... Just stay with you, like one of your familiars.

say:11:1541105009:1.text: I... I really do envy them.
say:11:1541105009:1.male: I... I really do envy them.
say:11:1541105009:1.female: I... I really do envy them.

say:12:1541105010:1.text: But the Wildborn still need me. They need a mage.
say:12:1541105010:1.source_cn: 但是，雅库伯尔还需要我，需要魔法师。
say:12:1541105010:1.male: But the Wildborn still need me. They need a mage.
say:12:1541105010:1.female: But the Wildborn still need me. They need a mage.

say:13:1541105011:1.text: Still, when you go back... you'll remember me, won't you? You'll remember the Wildborn, and the time we spent together, right?
say:13:1541105011:1.source_cn: 而且，等您回到未来，您一定也会记得我……记得在雅库伯尔...

say:15:1541105012:1.text: Thank you. That's more than enough for me.
say:15:1541105012:1.source_cn: 谢谢您。有您的承诺，我已经十分满足。

say:15:1541105012:1.female: Thank you. That's more than enough for me.

say:16:1541105013:1.text: Will you tell me more about your familiars? If I know they'll be there to watch over you once you return to the future... then I can be at peace.
say:16:1541105013:1.source_cn: 请再给我讲讲关于您使魔的事吧。只要能够知道，在您返回未...
